dublinCore.dc:title: HJ 143 IH: Making continuing appropriations for fiscal year 2026, and for other purposes.

action.action-desc: Referred to the Committee on Appropriations

form.official-title: Making continuing appropriations for fiscal year 2026, and for other purposes.

section.text: This joint resolution may be cited as the Continuing Appropriations Act, 2026.
The following sums are appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026.

appropriations-major.text: For necessary expenses of the Office of the Secretary, $48,000,000, of which not to exceed $5,000,000 shall be available for the immediate Office of the Secretary.

appropriations-intermediate.text: For necessary expenses of the Farm Production and Conservation mission area, $12,500,000.

appropriations-small.text: For necessary expenses of the Department of Agriculture to comply with hazardous waste laws, $3,000,000, to remain available until expended.
Of the amounts made available under this heading, $1,250,000 shall be transferred to the Office of Inspector General.

appropriations-major.text: For necessary expenses of the International Trade Administration, $560,000,000, to remain available until September 30, 2027.

appropriations-intermediate.header: National Institute of Standards and Technology
appropriations-intermediate.text: For necessary expenses of the National Institute of Standards and Technology, $1,065,000,000.

appropriations-small.text: For necessary expenses of industrial technology services, $175,000,000, to remain available until expended.

subsection.text: None of the funds appropriated by this title may be used in contravention of section 552a of title 5, United States Code.
Amounts made available by this title shall be available for the purposes described in the report accompanying this joint resolution.
